advisories.notes: Advisory names CVE-2024-45048 (GHSA-ghg6-32f9-2jp7, XXE), fixed in phpoffice/phpspreadsheet 1.29.1; the 2.x target in the advisory is not installable with pimcore/pimcore 10.6.9 (^1.15). The floor 1.30.7 is the first 1.x release without a published 1.x advisory, so it also covers the 28 advisories fixed after 1.29.1 and the two fixed in 1.29.1 itself (CVE-2024-45293, CVE-2024-45046). Run composer update phpoffice/phpspreadsheet once.

jQuery 3.4.1 is a private webpack module of the image editor (bundle.js module 42, no window.$). CVE-2020-11022: jQuery.htmlPrefilter becomes an identity function. CVE-2020-11023 (option wrapped in select) does not reproduce in Chrome 157, Firefox 159 or jsdom and is not changed in jQuery. Both are closed at page level: the image editor response carries a Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' in script-src, one nonce for the inline config script and sha256 hashes for the 22 fixed inline handler strings of the minipaint dialogs, so an onerror or other handler created by HTML parsing never runs. Untrusted data does reach jQuery HTML parsing (Image > Information puts EXIF values and file name of a file opened via File > Open into a div.trn that the translate plugin re-parses): a 38 character EXIF value and an option/select payload with an inline onerror execute on the unpatched editor in Chrome 157 and Firefox 159 and are inert with the policy, with and without the jQuery patch. The full menu (94 entries) and all 21 tools open without a policy violation. Run bin/console assets:install and bin/console cache:clear after applying; bundle.js.map is not regenerated.

advisories.notes: Link built on general.domain, or on the request host (without its own port; port only from a trusted proxy's X-Forwarded-Port) when framework.trusted_hosts is set; no link without either.

Invitation link and mail subject use the same trusted host; the failure message names the missing general.domain. getTokenLoginLinkAction returns its link only to the requesting admin and is unchanged.
Status, body and rate-limit behaviour no longer depend on whether the username exists. Response timing is not equalised: a mail is sent only for valid accounts.
New password equal to the current one is rejected, with old password and with reset token.

HTML test-mail content is sanitized (forms, controls, scripts, style, frames, comments, event handlers, script URLs, risky style attributes removed) and text/html test mails are sent without template rendering.

PDF preview sent inline with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'none' (limited to directives that cannot break the native viewers; the admin CSP listener is told to keep it via _pimcore_own_csp, requires the minipaint CSP patch). Browser behaviour is not covered by a PHP test; manual viewer check pending.
Same patch as CVE-2023-46722: PDF preview served with nosniff and a script-src 'none' policy.
sprintf() substitutes in a single pass; requires assets:install to reach public/bundles/pimcoreadmin.

advisories.impact: The advisory's fopen() of var/tmp/export-<id>.csv has no counterpart in 10.6.9: grid exports use the storage API (AssetHelperController.php:727, DataObjectHelperController.php:1335) and the report export opens its file with mode a+ (CustomReportController.php:480). The related hardening of error messages carrying absolute paths is PD-2026-004.
advisories.reason: CVE-2023-47636 not affected: the vulnerable export file handling does not exist in pimcore/pimcore 10.6.9; related hardening is PD-2026-004

advisories.notes: GHSA-hf99-42jw-j5hp. Pimcore Studio is not part of 10.6; the equivalent paths are the admin lost-password mail, the user invitation mail and the workflow notification deeplink, which carry the request-derived router base URL (X-Forwarded-Prefix behind a trusted proxy). Workflow notification template mails are sent without rendering by PD-2026-002. Host, X-Forwarded-Host, port and scheme cannot carry template syntax (Symfony rejects the host, the port is cast to int).
SQL injection through the property of /admin/notification/find-all filters; only title and date are accepted.

SQL injection through the field collection name in the data object listing JOIN; the name is quoted as a string literal. No 10.6.9 core caller passes request data to Listing\Concrete::addFieldCollection(), so this is reachable only through custom code.

The advisory lists only 12.3.3, but the Embed editable of 10.6.9 echoed any stored value as markup (Embera autoEmbed returns text around URLs unchanged). The editable now outputs a single http(s) URL only and escapes URLs no provider recognises.

GHSA-7gfm-v2fx-xrxm. Model getters reachable from sandboxed Twig (user.getPassword(), pimcore_user(1).getPassword(), asset.getData()) are blocked by the same sandbox policy as CVE-2026-11407; see tests/TwigSandboxTest.php.

advisories.impact: The advisory concerns Authentication::safelyUnserialize(), which does not exist in 10.6.9 (affected range starts at 11.0.0). lib/Tool/Authentication.php:79 reads the user attribute of the read-only admin session (:78), accepts it only as Pimcore\Model\User (:81) and reloads it by id (:83); no Pimcore code deserialises a session token string.
